title: 1155. Number of Dice Rolls With Target Sum

examples.explanation: You throw one die with 6 faces. There is only one way to get a sum of 3.
You throw two dice, each with 6 faces. There are 6 ways to get a sum of 7: 1+6, 2+5, 3+4, 4+3, 5+2, 6+1.
The answer must be returned modulo 109 + 7.
